items.description: No module under app/routes/ imports the database session dependency (e.g. get_db, AsyncSession); the boundary layer is free of any session import
No module under app/routes/ contains an import of any SQLAlchemy ORM symbol (Session, AsyncSession, declarative_base, or equivalent); the ORM-only contract excludes the boundary layer
No module under app/services/ contains an import of any SQLAlchemy ORM or session symbol; all ORM access is confined exclusively to app/repositories/
No hardcoded database connection string appears anywhere in application source; the app connects exclusively via the DATABASE_URL environment variable sourced from the post-checkout hook
The integration test suite connects to the database via DATABASE_URL bound to the real paired branch; no sqlite, in-memory, or mock DB driver is present in the pytest session configuration
The stock_records Alembic migration completes a single-step upgrade followed by a single-step downgrade against the real branch without error; the downgrade target is not the Alembic base revision
Rows seeded with per-run-unique keys before the stock_records migration upgrade are present after the upgrade completes, with every column value including created_at equal to the pre-migration value
Rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at the stock filing route mounts the stock filing form
The SKU input on the stock filing form carries its data-testid seam
The location input on the stock filing form carries its data-testid seam
The quantity input on the stock filing form carries its data-testid seam
The inventory_code input on the stock filing form carries its data-testid seam
The submit control on the stock filing form carries its data-testid seam
POST to the stock filing endpoint with a uuid-suffixed SKU and location persists a stock record durably capturing the exact SKU, location, quantity, and inventory_code
After the stock filing API responds with success, the stock filing form via <App> at the filing route renders a success state
Attempting to insert a stock_records row with a NULL value for sku, location, inventory_code, or quantity against the real branch database is rejected with an integrity error; no null row is stored
The real branch database rejects a direct insert of a stock_records row with quantity less than zero via the CHECK constraint ck_stock_records_quantity_non_negative; no negative row is stored

The stock service raises a validation error and returns without invoking the repository when a file-stock request carries a negative quantity; no row is persisted for the per-run-unique (sku, location) pair
When a file-stock request supplies an invalid or missing field, the boundary error payload includes the name of the specific offending field rather than a generic error message
The stock retrieve endpoint under app/routes/ returns a JSON response body; no server-rendered HTML template is produced for the stock resource
Rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at the stock retrieval route mounts the stock retrieval page
The quantity display element on the stock retrieval page carries its data-testid seam
The inventory_code display element on the stock retrieval page carries its data-testid seam
GET the stock retrieval endpoint for a uuid-suffixed (sku, location) pair previously filed returns the exact quantity and inventory_code as originally persisted
The quantity display on the stock retrieval page shows the exact quantity value returned by the stock retrieval API response
The inventory_code display on the stock retrieval page shows the exact inventory_code value returned by the stock retrieval API response
Filing two stock records with the same per-run-unique (sku, location) pair against the real branch database produces exactly one row in stock_records, confirmed by a delta count scoped to that pair

Two concurrent file requests for the same per-run-unique (sku, location) pair issued against the real branch under serialized session control result in exactly one row in stock_records, confirming the upsert transaction is atomic
A second file for the same per-run-unique (sku, location) pair that performs an in-place upsert leaves the created_at column value on the existing row unchanged from its original insert value
POST filing stock twice for the same uuid-suffixed (sku, location) pair results in exactly one row in the database for that pair with the updated quantity value
POST filing stock for a (sku, location) pair that already has a record returns a 2xx status code with no error payload
After filing stock for a SKU+location pair that already has a record, <App> at the filing route renders a success state
After filing stock for a duplicate SKU+location pair, no error message element is visible in the UI
